description: Built 31-10-2026 from the VATGER EDDK Tower SOP. Unlike LSZH's and EGCC's sources, this one gives NO time-of-day or day-of-week structure at all -- no stated hours for when 31R is preferred over 13L, no night curfew, no weekday/weekend split. The only conditioning factors VATGER states are wind (the 5kt tailwind threshold, see settings.json tailwindDryKt) and traffic demand ('high-demand periods' for 13R/31L), neither of which is a time-of-day rule this file's band model can express -- traffic-demand-triggered preference is what the engine's own traffic-based penalty system is for, not something to hand-code as a clock-time band. This plan therefore uses a single all-day band, with no time-based preference: wind (via tailwindDryKt) and the engine's own traffic scoring do the preference work a researched time band would otherwise do. This reflects a genuine gap in the source, not an invented simplification of real structure -- see docs/EDDK_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md section 6.
